name: logpush-syslog-hub
description: Open-source Cloudflare Logpush -> Syslog (CEF) forwarding hub, with a built-in web UI for managing multiple TCP destinations — API and UI deployed as a single Worker.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate && wrangler deploy

INGEST_SECRET.description: Secret Logpush sends as `Authorization: Bearer <value>` in the `header_Authorization` query parameter of the job's `destination_conf`. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

ADMIN_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign in to the built-in web UI and authenticate the admin API (`/api/admin/*`). Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
